notes.title: BEGINNING... almost
notes.content: [p]Hi everyone![/p][p align="start"]It's empty and lonely here for now, but soon, in small doses, I'll start sharing about the development process and the efforts involved.[/p][p align="start"]In the nearest exciting news: Midnight Souls is currently participating in The Six One Indie Showcase, and next week, it will be at the Tokyo Games Show (which is really awesome)! All signs point to this being the perfect moment to ramp up efforts and start releasing materials about the game, ranging in levels of interest[/p][p align="start"]So stay tuned for updates! Soon, this place will be so packed with content you might not even be able to squeeze through (or maybe you will)![/p]
